DeleteTask is now the request check and state read, checkDeleteBlockers before the transaction, one Modify calling removeTaskInState, and cleanupDeletedTaskWorktree after commit. checkDeleteBlockers (preconditions, first dependent, first parent reference) is the one blocker check used before the lock and again inside it; removeTaskInState (lookup, recheck, agent release, task removal, sprint planned and stretch pruning, quarantined-verdict pruning, audit human note via appendDeleteAuditNote) runs inside the one Modify; cleanupDeletedTaskWorktree (worktree path, removal or preservation, branch deletion ignoring its error, warnings) runs after commit. No lifecycle receipt is introduced. Every function in delete_task.go and delete_task_removal.go is within the S1 limits.

The existing TestDeleteTask_* tests in delete_task_test.go and both tests in delete_task_quarantined_verdict_test.go run unchanged in what they assert: successful and forced deletion, status, dependent and parent-reference refusals, agent state clearing, sprint scope pruning, audit trail, no-worktree and preserved-worktree results, commit failure leaving worktree and branch, and quarantined-verdict pruning. TestRemoveTaskInState_LockedDecisions adds the moved in-lock decisions no test reached by driving removeTaskInState directly: not-found, the locked recheck refusing the first dependent and the first parent reference with the pre-lock text and leaving state untouched, --force skipping the recheck, and an agent working on another task staying assigned. Negative proof, restored: removing the in-lock recheck failed the two recheck subtests.

The audit note keeps reading its status after removal, which the delete-task/success golden freezes.
